lines.en: Good afternoon, and welcome to the service desk. What can I do for you today? You look a little worried.
lines.pt: Boa tarde e bem-vindo ao balcão de serviços. O que posso fazer pelo senhor hoje? O senhor parece um pouco preocupado.

lines.en: Hello, Jin. I have been waiting for a sofa for three weeks, and nobody has called me back.
lines.pt: Olá, Jin. Estou esperando um sofá há três semanas e ninguém me ligou de volta.

lines.en: I am sorry to hear that. Could you give me your order number? I will check where the delivery is now.
lines.pt: Sinto muito. O senhor poderia me dar o número do pedido? Vou verificar onde está a entrega agora.

lines.en: It is forty-four seventy-one. The company promised delivery within five working days, and I paid an extra fee for express service.
lines.pt: É quarenta e quatro setenta e um. A empresa prometeu entrega em cinco dias úteis, e paguei uma taxa extra pelo serviço expresso.

lines.en: I can see the problem. The sofa left the warehouse on Monday, but the driver has not reached your street yet.
lines.pt: Estou vendo o problema. O sofá saiu do armazém na segunda, mas o motorista ainda não chegou à sua rua.

lines.en: Yesterday I took a day off work because someone said the sofa would arrive, and nobody came. That is unacceptable.
lines.pt: Ontem tirei um dia de folga porque alguém disse que o sofá chegaria, e ninguém veio. Isso é inaceitável.

lines.en: I apologise. Would you mind waiting a moment while I call the warehouse manager? I will be back soon.
lines.pt: Peço desculpas. O senhor se importaria de esperar um momento enquanto ligo para o gerente do armazém? Volto logo.

lines.en: Of course. While you are calling, could you also tell me whether I can get a refund for the express fee?
lines.pt: Claro. Enquanto liga, a senhora poderia me dizer também se posso receber o reembolso da taxa expressa?

lines.en: Good news. The manager says the driver has just left, so the sofa will be at your door by six this evening.
lines.pt: Boa notícia. O gerente diz que o motorista acabou de sair, então o sofá estará na sua porta até as seis desta noite.

lines.en: That is a relief. If it does not arrive tonight, I will ask for a full refund, so please note that.
lines.pt: Que alívio. Se não chegar esta noite, vou pedir o reembolso total, então por favor anote isso.

lines.en: Noted. We have also added a discount code to your account, and I really hope you enjoy the sofa once it arrives.
lines.pt: Anotado. Também acrescentamos um código de desconto à sua conta, e espero muito que goste do sofá quando chegar.

facts.big: I have been waiting for three weeks
facts.label: Reclamação educada
facts.sub: have been + -ing, nobody has…, I took…, Would you mind…?

facts.label: have been + -ing, for, since
facts.sub: Use para ações que começaram no passado e continuam: I have been waiting for three weeks. Use for com duração (three weeks) e since com ponto de partida (Monday). Não use o presente simples nesses casos.

facts.label: nobody has called, has just left
facts.sub: Use quando o resultado importa agora: Nobody has called me back. The driver has just left. Palavras comuns: just, yet, already, still. Com tempo finalizado, como yesterday, use passado simples.

compare.ask: I have been waiting for three weeks.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “estou esperando há três semanas” e “o senhor se importaria de esperar?”.
compare.tip: Diga: “I have been waiting for three weeks.”
compare.us: Em inglês: I have been waiting for three weeks; would you mind waiting? Use for ou since com o present perfect contínuo, e would you mind + -ing para pedir com educação.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: I have been waiting for three weeks.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I have been waiting since three weeks.
items.why: We say for three weeks or since the second of March.

items.s: Nobody has called me back is a present perfect sentence.
Yesterday I have taken a day off is correct.
items.why: With yesterday we use the past simple: I took.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I have been waiting since three weeks. → Falso (We say for three weeks or since the second of March.)
Nobody has called me back is a present perfect sentence. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Yesterday I have taken a day off is correct. → Falso (With yesterday we use the past simple: I took.)

pages.title: A late delivery · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy afternoon in Boston. Tess works at a store service desk. Theo walks in with a folder. He looks tired and a little angry. His new sofa has not arrived. He wants a clear answer.

“Good afternoon, and welcome to the service desk. What can I do for you today? You look a little worried.” says Tess. “Hello, Tess. I have been waiting for a sofa for three weeks, and nobody has called me back.” says Theo. “I am sorry to hear that. Could you give me your order number? I will check where the delivery is now.” says Tess.
